\paragraph{Operating constraints and evidence.} 
% Shared source: ANT-OBC-FR-001
The OBC must allocate record assembly separately from the science queue: 292 bytes per packed reference record and explicitly budgeted acquisition banks, stack and DMA; a two-bank histogram fixture adds 512 bytes. 804-byte illustrative payload working set; not total RAM or selected architecture.
% Shared source: ANT-OBC-FR-002
The OBC science queue must retain the corrected nominal workload without loss and provide nonvolatile spill for the accepted outage envelope; science RAM, persistent retention and total system memory must be allocated separately. Corrected annual nominal EMSC peak75336 bytes; seven-day outage1010028 bytes exceeds256KiB RAM.

% Shared source: ANT-OBC-FR-003
The OBC persistent science store must retain all unacknowledged records through the accepted contact-outage/retention envelope, including metadata/reserves; that envelope remains an open allocation. Corrected annual seven-day EMSC outage peak1010028 bytes;128MiB exceeds it before reserves.
% Shared source: ANT-OBC-FR-004
The OBC must provision total FSW/system memory and execution capacity separately from record assembly, queue and persistent storage, covering control, reconstruction, commands and fault handling. Limits remain open allocations. No integrated worst-case memory/execution budget.

% Shared source: ANT-OBC-FR-005
The OBC must maintain record integrity and sequence continuity across interrupted writes, reset and Relay interruption, recovering only complete records and retaining unacknowledged data. Reference CRC passes; atomic media writes and acknowledgements not implemented.
% Shared source: ANT-OBC-FR-006
The OBC must execute approved state-machine guards, validate commands, report faults and enter a defined safe state without uncommanded detector/Relay operation. Mode logic documented; flight integration and command integrity unqualified.

% Shared source: ANT-OBC-FR-007
The OBC must preserve payload timestamps, cell/configuration identity and linked livetime/background/quality metadata through storage and ground reconstruction, without treating unknown health as nominal. v3 has linked-session metadata; size/cadence and clock performance open.

\paragraph{Feasibility assessment.} The reference format makes the assembly and queue workloads concrete. A 256 KiB dedicated queue contains the corrected nominal sampled-gate workload; this is not a total OBC RAM requirement. The 128 MiB candidate store fails the separate 187498164-byte no-downlink grid-retention sensitivity, but that unmatched sensitivity is not an approved retention mission case. Sustained workload, outage policy and total system memory must be allocated before unconditional feasibility; media and reset tests follow at PDR.
